light.notes: Basil prefers at least six hours of direct sun or strong bright light. A sunny window can work, but weak northern winter light is not equivalent to outdoor sun.

container.notes: Sources support container growing but this pack does not yet support a general volume or depth figure.

water.notes: Use well-drained growing medium with moisture retention. Containers dry faster; avoid treating this as a fixed daily amount.

establishment.notes: Outdoor sowing/planting follows frost safety; the profile intentionally does not assign universal calendar months.
